metadata.title: नीलगिरी के आदिवासी झोपड़ों की कहानी । The story of Adivasi mud houses in Nilgiri । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Nilgiri is a block in Baleshwar district of Odisha. At one time, Rajputs ruled here, and their palace remains intact till date. But the majority of the population of this block is tribal. In this episode, we take you to one of the small adivasi villages, and see that most of the Adivasis still live in mud houses.

Have they chosen to live in these mud houses, or do they have no choice in the matter?
Let's find out.

#Odisha #Main_Bhi_Bharat
